brief:
The Israeli military carried out artillery strikes across southern Lebanese towns and villages on Sunday, targeting the Zoutar River valley and the Ali al-Tahir heights, Shehab Wire reported. The bombardment struck multiple locations in the region simultaneously, with Lebanese sources confirming ongoing strikes throughout the day.

The attacks focused on civilian areas near the border with Israel. The shelling of the Ali al-Tahir heights and Zoutar River valley added to a pattern of military operations against southern Lebanon's populated districts. The strikes were among the latest in a series of cross-border incidents affecting the region.
